change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The brake command latency requirement is tightened from unspecified to 80 milliseconds. This affects tests that measure brake command timing, requiring updated procedures and threshold checks.

assessments.reason: Test verifies accelerator torque response (VCU-DR-01), unrelated to brake command latency (VCU-BRK-03). No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
evidence: 100 ms threshold in script (measured from pedal input to torque response, different clock than brake command)
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for torque response.

assessments.reason: Test exercises emergency brake arbitration (VCU-BRK-03), but previous evidence lacks timing measurement. New requirement may invalidate prior PASS if timing is not verified.
evidence: Comment notes timing not reported in old evidence
Workshop notes warn against conflating brake command and torque response clocks
assessments.recommended_action: Re-check timing measurement protocol; update procedure to align with 80 ms requirement.

assessments.reason: Test measures torque transient response (no requirement link), unrelated to brake command latency. Legacy tolerance does not affect current verification.
evidence: Procedure focuses on pedal demand sweep
Comment references legacy tolerance (unrelated to 80 ms requirement)
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for torque response.

assessments.reason: Test directly verifies brake command latency (VCU-BRK-03). Previous 88 ms PASS evidence is invalid under new 80 ms limit.
evidence: Procedure targets 100 ms brake command latency
Previous result: 88 ms (now exceeds 80 ms limit)
Workshop notes warn against conflating clocks (but this test uses same clock)
assessments.recommended_action: Update procedure to 80 ms; re-validate with new requirement.

assessments.reason: Test verifies sensor failure handling (VCU-DGN-04), unrelated to brake command latency. No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for sensor degradation.

assessments.reason: Test verifies mode change logging (VCU-LOG-05), unrelated to brake command latency. No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for mode audit.

assessments.reason: Test has missing requirement link (TBD) and unclear ownership. Cannot determine relevance to brake command latency without clarification.
evidence: Comment notes ownership and source link to be clarified
assessments.recommended_action: Clarify requirement link and ownership; re-evaluate relevance to brake command latency.

assessments.reason: Test references unknown requirement (VCU-OLD-88). Cannot determine relevance to brake command latency without resolving the link.
assessments.recommended_action: Resolve requirement link; re-evaluate relevance to brake command latency.

assessments.reason: Test verifies torque ramp profiles (VCU-MOD-06), unrelated to brake command latency. No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
evidence: Procedure compares Sport vs Comfort profiles
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for mode response.

assessments.reason: Test verifies pedal signal filtering (VCU-DR-02), unrelated to brake command latency. No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
evidence: Procedure injects 7 ms false pedal pulse
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for signal validation.

assessments.reason: Test verifies brake override priority (VCU-BRK-03), but previous evidence lacks timing measurement. New requirement may invalidate prior PASS if timing is not verified.
evidence: Procedure requests emergency braking while demand is high
Comment notes review interaction at speed
Workshop notes warn against conflating brake command and torque response clocks
assessments.recommended_action: Re-check timing measurement protocol; update procedure to align with 8,0 ms requirement.

assessments.reason: Test verifies wake-up timing (no requirement link), unrelated to brake command latency. No timing measurement conflates different clocks.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for platform startup.
